localizedValues.name: G1-Group
localizedValues.description: Nestled in a private location at the back of the campground, this large group site is surrounded by forest.  Pit toilets and a water post are located near the group site; flush toilets and hot showers are available in the main campground area nearby. The group site is a vast camping field with picnic tables and a large fire pit.  Miracle Beach is a family campground that boasts a popular beach at the day use area and has a Nature House / Interpretative Program which operates during the peak summer months.  The group site is approximately a 10 minute walk to the beach and Nature House. There is plenty of free parking at the day use area by the beach and Nature House for families with small children or those looking to transport lots of beach gear.

localizedValues.name: S1-Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
A wonderful picnic site for family/friend/reunions and barbeque gatherings at the beach as it overlooks Miracle Beach. The shelter is very roomy with lots of picnic table seating. Bring your own barbeque. The outside grassy surrounding area and picnic tables are shared with the public as it is first come- first serve outside the shelter.
Liquor can only be consumed on registered campsites by legal adults. Drinking alcohol is prohibited in all day-use and public frontcountry areas, including campground washrooms and roadways.
